addons.name: Jellyfin
addons.author: Korie
addons.description: Films and series from your own Jellyfin server, played in Korie's player. Finds the server on your network or takes its address, signs in with Quick Connect or a password, and keeps one sign-in per Korie profile so everyone has their own Continue Watching.

addons.name: Open Films
addons.author: Korie
addons.description: Two free films from the Blender Foundation (CC BY), streamed from download.blender.org and played in Korie's own player, with Resume. Also the smallest example of a Korie add-on.

addons.name: Radio
addons.author: Korie
addons.description: Internet radio by country, from the free Radio Browser directory. Find a station in Search and it plays in the background, with the now-playing pill on Home.
